title: Associativity of the specified action-site tensor comparison
statement: For a twisted action-site Presentation P [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data], let U be the specified underlying-module functor. For all source module sheaves M,N,T, the composite U(associator) then P.tensor(M,N tensor T).hom then identity tensor P.tensor(N,T).hom equals P.tensor(M tensor N,T).hom then P.tensor(M,N).hom tensor identity then the target associator. These are the existing source and target tensor structures and the specified comparisons; no unit, internal-Hom or evaluation assertion is included.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_associativity (P : Presentation J s R a) :
    letI := P.category
    let U := P.modules.functor ⋙ forgetPairs (sigma J s R a)
    ∀ M N T : Modules P.coefficient,
      U.map (α_ M N T).hom ≫ (P.tensor M (N ⊗ T)).hom ≫
          tensorMap (𝟙 _) (P.tensor N T).hom =
        (P.tensor (M ⊗ N) T).hom ≫ tensorMap (P.tensor M N).hom (𝟙 _) ≫
          (α_ (U.obj M) (U.obj N) (U.obj T)).hom
